description: Storm Drain Sub-Basin Boundaries - City of Newton is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors City of Newton GIS. This data layer contains the boundaries of the storm water sub-basins for the city of Newton. These sub-basins are roughly equivalent to watersheds. Related line and point drainage basin coverages may be found in the Storm Water Collection System Lines and Storm Water Collection System Points data layers. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For educational or non-commercial use only.. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
